Unfortunately, negatively impressed.
Jul 2024 • Solo
Da Nang Food Advice - Another place for a casual classic Indian cuisine, located in the heart of the touristic area of Da Nang, with lot of positive customers reviews is Patakka @patakkadanang . 
The place, simple but cute, claim to deliver original Indian Street Food recipes. 

Here our dinner choices:

- Dahi Ke Kabab.

- Paneer Tikka.

- Laal Maas.

- Jeera Rice.

- Butter Naan 

While the kitchen lacked to impress us in general, the over usage of flavor enhancers, in the Paneer Tikka and especially in the Laal Maas, left us with negative impression on the experience. 
The Laal Maas curry sauce was so salty that the tenderness and juiciness of the Mutton was completely overwhelmed unfortunately, making the dish difficult to eat and digest.
For this reason, we do not feel comfortable to suggest this restaurant.
